 Friends, the Butengo team announces a new vector of studio development. Our team is finally assembled and ready to create interesting projects for you. We, recently, officially opened the office and have already started the arrangement. We'll be registering Instagram for the studio soon so you can follow the team's workflow.
   We also want to inform you about the start of the sale. Discount 75 percent off. We plan to spend all the money earned from this sale as follows:

[list]
[*] 10% donation to the wildlife fund
[*] 40% office arrangement
[*] 20% of the needs of the team
[*] 30% development of the project "I will eat you 2"
[/list]

We will keep a report on our Instagram.

P.S. Thanks for your support.
